Government of India
Directorate General of Health Services
Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation
FDA Bhawan, Kotla Road, New Delhi
(New Drugs Division)

FDA Bhawan, Kotla Road,

New Delhi,

Date: | ey
To
All State/UT Drugs Controllers,
Sub: Prescribing Information Leaflet change for “Tramadol” marketed in the
country- Reg.
Sir,
The National Co-ordination Centre for Pharmacovigilance Programme of India (NCC-
PvP), functioning at IPC, Ghaziabad has forwarded their recommendation based on
ADR reports on Tramadol which was discussed by them in the 18" Signal Review
Panel (SRP) under the programme meeting held on 42" March, 2021 with an
objective to detect Signal/Prescribing Information Leaflet change from Indian
database and promote patient safety.
In the meeting, PvPI has evaluated the reported ADRs for Tramadol on the basis of
Individual Case Study Reports (ICSRs) and recommended CDSCO to take
necessary steps to incorporate Urinary Retention as an adverse drug reaction in
the Prescribing Information Leaflet (PIL) of Tramadol marketed in the country.
Subsequently, PvPI recommendations was deliberated in the Subject Expert
Committee (SEC-Analgesic & Rheumatology) meeting held on 19.05.2022 at
CDSCO (HQ), New Delhi. .

After detailed deliberation, the committee recommended that CDSCO should
request the State Drugs Controllers to direct the manufacturers of the drug to include
Tramadol induced Urinary Retention as an adverse drug reaction in the package
insert of the drug as suggested by PvPI.
The recommendation of the SEC has been considered by this office.
Accordingly, you are requested to direct the manufacturers of Tramadol under your
jurisdiction to incorporate Tramadol induced Urinary Retention as an adverse drug
reaction in the package insert /promotional literature of the drug.
Action taken in this regard may be intimated to this office.
Yours faithfully,
a
Dr. V.G. Somani
Drugs Controller General (India)

All Zonal / Sub Zonal offices of CDSCO.
